scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --directory backend && pnpm --filter frontend exec playwright install chromium && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs
scripts.check:api: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend lint-imports --no-logo && uv run --directory backend mypy && uv run --directory backend pytest --cov && node scripts/gen-api.mjs --check
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter frontend lint && prettier --check . && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory backend ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory backend ruff format .
